name: @agent-plugins/apifox
description: Apifox CLI skills for managing API projects, running interface automation tests, importing/exporting API docs, and handling branch collaboration. Use when the user asks to manage Apifox project resources (endpoints, environments, schemas, mocks, branches), run test cases/scenarios/suites via the apifox CLI, import or export OpenAPI/Postman/Apifox-native formats, or debug apifox CLI behavior.
